events.title: Historic US-Japan Joint FX Intervention
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan MOF executed unprecedented coordinated FX intervention ~July 31, 2026 to support the yen. Japan spent ~$75B, US contributed $5-10B via FIMA facility. Yen has already erased half its gains, trading back near 159. First joint US-Japan intervention in history.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis — Iran War Ongoing
events.summary: US and Israel launched air war against Iran in late February 2026. Iran has blocked Strait of Hormuz since Feb 28. Oil supply severely disrupted. Trump claims US controls Hormuz (Aug 12); Iran demands conditions including unfreezing assets and end to Israel's wars. Active conflict status with no resolution in sight.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — DR Congo
events.summary: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, second-deadliest ever. 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths as of early August 2026. Caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (different from Zaire species, complicating treatment). WHO warns could surpass 2014-2016 outbreak that killed 11,000+. Declared public health emergency.

events.title: France Fiscal Crisis — New Eurozone Debt Epicenter
events.summary: France's central government deficit hit €107 billion in H1 2026, 14.4% above budget. National debt at record €3.5 trillion. Interest costs jumped 19% to €34.5B. Full-year deficit ratio could reach 8%. Le Monde warns of 'snowball effect'. Potential new epicenter of eurozone debt crisis.

events.title: Japan JGB Yield Surge + BOJ Policy Crisis
events.summary: 2-year JGB yield hit 31-year high of 1.64% on bets BOJ raises rates in September. BOJ's rate-hike path colliding with PM Takaichi's spending plans driving yields higher. Fund managers chasing retail cash as JGBs surge. Yen intervention unraveling. Structural fiscal-monetary tension escalating.
